canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON; recursively sorted keys; separators comma and colon; ensure_ascii=false; trailing newline excluded

universe_construction.source: same 501-symbol universe as cross-sectional-momentum-v1.json: real point-in-time SP500 members (universe_pit.py) intersected with stored bars
universe_construction.grouping: GICS Sector via backend/app/universe_sectors.py (equity_sectors table), today's classification snapshot, not point-in-time
universe_construction.date_alignment: SPY's own stored trading-date calendar from 2001-01-01 onward, identical to cross-sectional-momentum-v1.json

scope_decision: Reuses backend/app/research.py:etf12_rotation_bootstrap completely unmodified -- a new sector-aggregation step (equal-weighted daily return across eligible members per GICS sector, compounded into a synthetic per-sector index level) replaces the 12-ETF panel with an 11-GICS-sector panel; no new statistical engine.

aggregation.method: equal-weighted average of eligible members' simple daily returns per GICS sector per session
aggregation.eligibility: real point-in-time SP500 membership (members_asof) AND real non-NaN close on session t and t-1
aggregation.weighting_rationale: equal-weighted, not cap-weighted, specifically to avoid one or two megacap names dominating the sector aggregate (named alternative (b) in the operationalization record)
aggregation.sparse_date_handling: a sector-date with fewer than 2 eligible members contributes a 0% return for that session only (disclosed, not silently dropped); not expected to bind in practice for GICS sectors within the SP500
aggregation.index_construction: level_t = level_{t-1} * (1 + return_t), starting level 100 per sector

formation.definition: F_s(t) = level_s(t)/level_s(t-252) - 1, per sector, computed through session t only
formation.rationale: ~12-month horizon matching the natural cadence of a sector/thematic rotation claim (capex, rate, demand cycles play out over quarters to years) -- independently chosen, not copied from cross-sectional-momentum-v1's 126-session individual-stock horizon

holding.rationale: same monthly-rebalance convention as every other protocol this session, for rebalance-cadence comparability

rebalance_grid.definition: rebalance dates at session indices 252, 273, 294, ... through the last index with a full forward window available, on the SPY-anchored calendar

rank.tie_breaking: average rank (ties split the contested rank positions evenly)

estimand.statistic: pooled Spearman rank correlation between sector formation rank and sector forward rank, across all (sector, rebalance date) pairs
estimand.evidential_status: confirmatory, subject to the today's-GICS-classification-not-point-in-time caveat in protocol section 2

bootstrap.p_value_convention: one-sided; fraction of resamples with resampled pooled correlation >= observed, plus add-one correction
bootstrap.joint_resampling: the same resampled date-block sequence is applied to all 11 sector-index series simultaneously in each resample, preserving real contemporaneous cross-sector correlation

material_and_consistent_requires: reported together with the section-2 today's-classification caveat, never as an unqualified confirmation
gates.reproducibility: byte-identical correlation/p-value artifact on an independent rerun against the same fingerprinted data

multiplicity.parameter_grid: none in this run; one locked formation window, holding horizon, and aggregation methodology

scope_exclusions.no_costs: out of scope -- this tests the estimand only, per hypothesis-engineering.md's separation of claim and trade
scope_exclusions.today_classification_not_point_in_time: see protocol section 2 -- a stock reclassified between GICS sectors mid-history is attributed to its current sector for its whole price history

data.fingerprint_method: SHA-256 incremental ORDER BY symbol,date over (symbol, date, close, gics_sector) actually used, plus the eligibility mask
data.fingerprint_pending_reason: specification locked before execution; fingerprint recorded fresh at execution time
